results.title: Full URL with protocol, www, path and query gives the root domain

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Licter" is selected with an empty website field
steps.expected: The website field is empty and the avatar shows the letter "L"

steps.title: When the user enters a full URL in the website field
steps.expected: The value is typed, no error is shown while typing

steps.title: And the field loses focus
steps.expected: No inline error is shown

steps.title: Then the derived root domain is shown under the brand name
steps.expected: "licter.com"

steps.title: And the logo preview is retrieved for that domain
steps.expected: The 32px avatar shows the logo found for licter.com instead of the letter "L"

results.notes: Test data adapted as the precondition allows (same as GEO-1260 run): "Licter" is a Brandfetch suggestion, so C = "Lictorix Geo" (offered only through the "Custom Brand" row, first row, "?" avatar). Given: empty field, green 32px lettermark "L". While typing "https://www.licter.com/fr/about?x=1": aria-invalid=false, border slate-200, no error. On blur: no error; card shows "Lictorix Geo" with "licter.com" under the name; avatar replaced by 32x32 src https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (Licter logo rendered). The field keeps the typed URL as is (only the derived domain is normalized). Logo lookup request: GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com -> {"domain":"licter.com"}.

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Licter" is selected with an empty website field
steps.expected: The website field is empty

steps.title: When the user enters an address with the http protocol and the field loses focus

steps.title: And the user replaces it with an address with the www prefix and the field loses focus

steps.title: And the user replaces it with a domain with a trailing slash and the field loses focus

results.title: Inline error shown on Discover Categories and cleared once the value is valid or empty

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Licter" is selected with a market and an empty website field
steps.expected: The website field is empty

steps.expected: Red border and "Enter a valid website, such as example.com."; the step is not left

steps.title: And the user corrects the value to a valid domain
steps.expected: The red border and the message disappear

steps.expected: The error is shown again

steps.expected: The discovery loading screen is displayed and the Categories step opens

results.notes: Step 2: "john@licter.com" typed then "Discover Categories" clicked without blurring first: red border + exact message appear, step not left, no discover-categories request. Step 3: retyping "licter.com" clears the red border and the message immediately (before blur); on blur "licter.com" + logo appear. Step 4: "localhost" + blur shows the error again. Step 5: clearing the field removes the border/message immediately; on blur the lettermark "L" comes back. Step 6: "Discover Categories" shows "Discovering Categories - Scanning how AI engines see Lictorix Geo across your markets." (step3_then_loading.png) then the Categories step opens ("Location Intelligence Platform", "Geospatial Analytics Software"); request body entityDomain = null. SIDE FINDING (outside the TC assertions, see SIDE_stale_domain_after_invalid.png): after a valid value, replacing it with an invalid one ("localhost") shows the error but the card still shows "licter.com" and the Licter logo under the brand name (stale preview of the last valid domain) until the field is emptied or corrected.
